before.books/machines-c.lisp:
; Layer C in the served core (C-ONE-ASSEMBLY; seam C-S1, docs/c-ordered-runs.md
; §4a and §8): the engine's resident tables registered as core children, and
; each transaction's field-row stripe. The identity decision over them is
; machines-c-groups.lisp's (two exact reads); a transaction's writes go
; through the private successor (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp). The run
; and range assemblies are range-served.lisp's.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "range-served")
(include-book "machines-b")
(include-book "c-snapshot")
(include-book "checkpoint-summary-state")
(include-book "run-physical-geometry")
(include-book "run-physical-harvest")
(include-book "startup-genesis-state")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Field rows. B's format work uses a 128-row stripe per format slot from row 0
; (commit.lisp: base = 128 * row); transaction T's stripe is the
; *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*-row stripe ending (transactions - T) stripes before
; the table's end. machines-b sizes the table for both (fn2-b-field-rows). In
; a stripe (C-STRIPE): the successor's 24 write slots from +0, one 48-row
; block each (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp), then the exact lookup's area
; from +1152: its query at +4 (the identity decision's key: namespace, name,
; profile, algorithm, digest), the run reader at +84 (its rows also take the
; entry a bind writes).
(defconst *fn2-idc-stride* *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*)
(defconst *fn2-idc-b-stripe* 128)
(defconst *fn2-succ-slots* 24)
(defconst *fn2-succ-block* 48)
(defconst *fn2-idc-ident* (* *fn2-succ-slots* *fn2-succ-block*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-eb* (+ *fn2-idc-ident* 4))
(defconst *fn2-idc-rb* (+ *fn2-idc-eb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(assert-event (and (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-reader-fields*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ (* (- *fn2-succ-slots* 1) *fn2-succ-block*) *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (equal (fn2-b-field-rows '((:t . 3) (:format-slots . 2))) (+ (* 2 *fn2-idc-b-stripe*) (* 3 *fn2-idc-stride*) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* *fn2-b-checkpoint-field-rows*))))

;; The overlay rows a profile gets when it names none (:identity-overlays):
;; a batch takes one private overlay per schema it writes, and a POST
;; writes up to 10 today (the five identity records, article, outcome,
;; counts, overview, addr) of the 16 a transaction could name; B keeps two
;; batches in flight (its two commit rows) and the sealer works on the
;; frozen ones behind them. So 16 schemas x 3 batches. Each overlay in use
;; holds one arena of :identity-arena-bytes from the pool; the pool must
;; carry them (c-ordered-runs.md §5, capacity).
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlays-default* 48)
;; The sealer's merge (C5, sealer.lisp) reads at most eight sources, one run
;; cursor each, after every read row's (t + 9R ..).
(defconst *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 8)
;; A reader merges at most *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* (8) sources of a schema:
;; its overlays (active, frozen or private) and its live runs. The sealer
;; keeps a schema to *fn2-idc-run-budget* runs (it merges every run once a
;; schema holds that many, sealer.lisp) and stage keeps it to
;; *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* overlays (a transaction that would take one more
;; waits, :full, until the sealer catches up: machines-c-stage.lisp).
(defconst *fn2-idc-run-budget* 4)
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* (- *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* *fn2-idc-run-budget*))
(defun fn2-idc-profilep (profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-profile-t profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-succ-slots* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
                             (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlay-entries 256 profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-runs 64 profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :run-cache 1024 profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-arena-bytes 65536 profile))
      ;; Layer D's read rows (C-S4, machines-c-read.lisp): R of them, each
      ;; with 8 range sources, a lookup row and cursor after the
      ;; transactions' (t + R) and 8 source cursors after those (t + 9R).
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 9 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 1))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 9 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 1)))
      (<= (+ (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix (fn2-b-format-slots profile)))
             (* *fn2-idc-stride* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* *fn2-b-checkpoint-field-rows*
             (* *fn2-b-read-stride* (fn2-b-read-rows profile)))
          (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :format-field-slots (fn2-b-field-rows profile) profile)))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ 4 (fn2-b-upload-windows profile) (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile)))))

;; Each child's init is a function whose guard is proved here once, so the
;; core init's guard (assembly-init) meets only the opaque profile predicate.
(defmacro fn2-idc-child (field stobj init why)
 (let ((fn (fn2-columns-sym stobj "-INIT-FOR")))
  `(progn
    (defun ,fn (profile ,stobj)
     (declare (xargs :stobjs ,stobj :guard (fn2-idc-profilep profile)
                     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep)))))
     ,init)
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-TYPE")
     (implies (and (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") ,stobj) (fn2-idc-profilep profile))
              (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-WFP")
     (implies (fn2-idc-profilep profile) (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "-WFP") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (in-theory (disable ,fn))
    (defcorechild ,field ,stobj :init (,fn profile ,stobj) :profilep (fn2-idc-profilep profile) :why ,why))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-idc-profilep))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-csnapshot fn2-csnapshot (fn2-csnapshot-init 1 fn2-csnapshot)
 "One exact-owner resident metadata cut excludes staging and materialization until released.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-id-decides fn2-id-decides (fn2-id-decides-init (fn2-profile-t profile) fn2-id-decides)
 "One identity decision per transaction survives the transaction's yields (C-S1).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-overlays fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-init (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile) fn2-overlays)
 "Bounded sorted overlays hold facts not yet sealed into runs.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-overlay-index fn2-overlay-index
 (fn2-overlay-index-init (* (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
                            (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlay-entries 256 profile))) fn2-overlay-index)
 "Each overlay's key-ordered index of its arena's entries.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-installed fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-init (+ (fn2-b-capacity :identity-runs 64 profile) (fn2-b-capacity :extent-slots 16 profile)) fn2-run-installed)
 "The resident view of each schema's sealed runs.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-cursors fn2-run-cursors
 (fn2-run-cursors-init (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile) fn2-run-cursors)
 "A decision's resumable run cursor (cursor row = decision row), then each read row's lookup cursor and its range sources' (C-S4).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases
 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-init (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile) fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
 "Every actual C cursor can retain one exact selected physical source across yields.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-loads fn2-run-loads
 (fn2-run-load-profile-init profile fn2-run-loads)
 "A private authenticated 64KiB page and sector workspace per active physical cursor.")
(defcorechild fn2-core-run-load-ops fn2-run-load-ops
 :init (fn2-run-load-ops-init (fn2-profile-o profile) fn2-run-load-ops)
 :profilep (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-profile-o profile))
 :harvest (fn2-run-load-harvest ((fn2-core-run-loads fn2-run-loads) (fn2-core-run-load-ops fn2-run-load-ops)))
 :why "Route exact physical read completions before operation finish, without scanning active cursors.")
(defcorechild fn2-core-run-load-geometry fn2-run-load-geometry
 :init (fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init profile fn2-run-load-geometry)
 :profilep (fn2-run-load-geometry-profilep profile)
 :why "Readonly profile-derived cursor/checker geometry binds the cold loader capability scan.")
(defcorechild fn2-core-run-load-readiness fn2-run-load-readiness
 :init (fn2-run-load-readiness-init 1 fn2-run-load-readiness) :profilep t
 :why "The cold capability scan retains selected identity, exact EOF and admissions serial across turns.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-paths fn2-run-paths
 (fn2-run-paths-init (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile)) fn2-run-paths)
 "Each cursor's descent, one row per level.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-cache fn2-run-cache (fn2-run-cache-init (fn2-b-capacity :run-cache 1024 profile) fn2-run-cache)
 "Verified run pages, keyed by exact (unit, allocation counter).")

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Decision D's stripe base, or :bounds when D is no decision row or the
; stripes would reach into B's (FCROWS format slots).
(defun fn2-idc-stripe (d fcrows fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (let* ((n (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides)) (rows (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))
  (if (and (natp d) (< d n) (natp rows) (natp n)
           (<= (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix fcrows)) (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n))))
      (mv :ok (+ (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n)) (* *fn2-idc-stride* d)))
    (mv :bounds 0))))

; The output positions of OUTS from POS, for the shape theorems
; (machines-c-successor.lisp's fn2-idc-fn-shape).
(defun fn2-idc-shape-outs (outs pos)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom outs) nil (cons (list (car outs) pos) (fn2-idc-shape-outs (cdr outs) (+ 1 pos)))))
before.books/machines-c-successor.lisp:
; Layer C in the served core, seam C-S3 (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §8 item 8):
; every engine write of a transaction goes through its batch's private
; successor. A transaction's write slots are declared at :prepare (put, arg,
; arg-octets, resolve); in its :ready arm, in one transition, stage computes
; every slot's row against the tip and holds room, out reads an assigned
; value, B admits the member, and bind writes every row into the batch's
; private overlays; release frees the slots at the outcome. B's commit kind
; publishes a batch (its private overlays, of every schema, readable in one
; step) or drops it. The tables, the engine row, the defcosts and the core
; wrappers (fn2-successor-prepare-events and -commit-events, materialized in
; assembly-callbacks-c-prepare and -commit) are three books': this one holds the tables,
; the declaring calls (put, arg, arg-octets) and resolve; machines-c-stage
; stage and out; machines-c-bind bind, release, publication, the defcosts
; and the wrappers (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-sealer-kind")
(include-book "identity-workspace-geometry")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
;; The assembly's dispatchers case-split over every schema id when open; the
;; successor treats them as opaque (their type facts are the assembly's).
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; C-ENGINE-OWNER (as built, C1c): the engine's workspaces (overlay arenas,
; the bind scratch, the sealer's pages) are owned by the sealer machine's row:
; kind = fn2-sealer's position in the registry (the index's *FN2-SEALER-KIND*,
; asserted equal in machines-c-sealer.lisp), local slot 0, generation 1. The
; local slot, not the global id, because these constants are used before the
; index exists.
(make-event (value `(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-kind*
                     ,(let ((pos (position-eq 'fn2-sealer (fn2-machine-names (w state))))) (if (natp pos) pos 254)))))
(assert-event (not (equal *fn2-idc-owner-kind* 254)))
(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-slot* 0)
(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-gen* 1)
; The bind scratch takes one slot's octets at a time: an entry's octet
; fields in field order from 0.


; A write slot's block of field rows (C-STRIPE): the staged row at +0 (key
; fields then value fields, at most 12), the args as given at +12 (a value,
; a packed handle for :out, an octet reference), the args evaluated at +24
; (a fold's event args), the key's row
; read from the installed runs at +36 (its value fields, at most 8).
(defconst *fn2-succ-entry* 0)
(defconst *fn2-succ-raw* 12)
(defconst *fn2-succ-eval* 24)
(defconst *fn2-succ-res* 36)
; Row 44 of a staged slot's block: 1 when stage found it fresh (an insert
; new at the tip, a fold step applied), 0 when it binds nothing (a :union
; key already present, a fold :unchanged). An arg (:new K) reads it.
(defconst *fn2-succ-fresh* 44)
(defconst *fn2-succ-fields-max* 12)
(defconst *fn2-succ-values-max* 8)
(assert-event (<= (+ *fn2-succ-res* *fn2-succ-values-max*) *fn2-succ-fresh*))
(assert-event (< *fn2-succ-fresh* *fn2-succ-block*))

;; Every assembled schema fits a slot: at most 12 entry fields and, for a
;; fold, 8 value fields and 12 args per event kind; its octet fields fit the
;; bind scratch together.
(defun fn2-succ-kinds-fit (sid kinds)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom kinds) (and (<= (nfix (fn2-fold-arity sid (car kinds))) *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (fn2-succ-kinds-fit sid (cdr kinds)))))
(defun fn2-succ-octets-total (sid f n)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil :measure (nfix (- (nfix n) (nfix f)))))
 (if (<= (nfix n) (nfix f)) 0 (+ (nfix (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid f)) (fn2-succ-octets-total sid (+ 1 (nfix f)) n))))
(defun fn2-succ-schemas-fit (ids)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom ids)
     (let* ((sid (car ids)) (nf (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0)))
      (and (<= nf *fn2-succ-fields-max*)
           (or (not (fn2-run-layout-fold-p sid)) (<= (- nf (fn2-run-layout-keys sid)) *fn2-succ-values-max*))
           (fn2-succ-kinds-fit sid *fn2-run-fold-kinds*)
           (<= (fn2-succ-octets-total sid 0 nf) *fn2-idc-scratch-bytes*)
           (fn2-succ-schemas-fit (cdr ids))))))
(assert-event (fn2-succ-schemas-fit *fn2-run-assembled-ids*))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Tables. The engine row: the bind scratch (held once taken), the arena
; size, the next overlay sequence number. A transaction row (one per
; transaction, as its decision row): its phase, its batch and commit
; position once bound,
; resolve's progress (slot RI, run bound RBOUND), and an exact lookup's
; (machines-c-groups.lisp: LPHASE, LBOUND, LROW, LVER). A slot row (row
; T * 24 + I): schema, kind (:insert, or one of the folds' event
; kinds), the masks of args given (SET), given :event (EVENTS) and given
; :out (OUTS), what resolve found (FOUND, the schema's run version VRUN), the
; staged entry's SIZE, the owner its octet args are read under, the args
; declared late (LATE, C-S3a: octets given between stage and bind) and the
; late args filled since the last stage (FILLED).
; PUBLISHED: the greatest commit position publication has made readable
; (C-S4 amendment (c): D's frontier reads it, never derives it from overlays).
(defcolumns fn2-id-engine ((scratch :bool) (slot :u32) (gen :u60) (arena :u32) (seq :u60) (published :u60)))
(defun fn2-id-engine-init-arena (bytes fn2-id-engine)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-id-engine :guard (unsigned-byte-p 32 bytes)))
 (let ((fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-init 1 fn2-id-engine)))
  (fn2-id-engine-set-arena 0 bytes fn2-id-engine)))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-id-engine fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-init-arena (fn2-idc-profile-arena profile) fn2-id-engine)
 "The engine's bind scratch, arena size and overlay sequence (C-S3).")
(defcolumns fn2-succ-txns
 ((phase (:enum fn2-succ-phase (:idle :open :staged :bound :published)))
  (batch :u60) (event :u60)
  (ri :u32) (rstate (:enum fn2-succ-resolve (:fresh :next :look))) (rbound :u60)
  (lphase (:enum fn2-succ-lookup (:idle :overlays :runs :scan))) (lbound :u60) (lrow :u32) (lver :u60)))
(make-event
 `(defcolumns fn2-succ-slots
   ((phase (:enum fn2-succ-slot-phase (:empty :put :resolved)))
    (sid :u60) (kind (:enum fn2-succ-kind ,(append (cons :insert *fn2-run-fold-kinds*) '(:depend))))
    (set :u32) (events :u32) (outs :u32) (found :bool) (vrun :u60) (size :u32)
    (oset :bool) (sk :u8) (ss :u32) (sg :u60) (late :u32) (filled :u32) (unchanged :bool))))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-succ-txns
 (fn2-succ-txns-init (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) fn2-succ-txns)
 "A transaction's writes survive its yields between :prepare and its outcome (C-S3); then one row per read row, its exact lookup's continuation (C-S4).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-succ-slots fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-init (* *fn2-succ-slots* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))) fn2-succ-slots)
 "Each transaction's write slots (C-S3).")

; The first overlay row at or after O in phase PHASE (and, for a private
; one, of batch B); past the last, the row count.
(defun fn2-idc-find-overlay (k o phase b fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp k))))
 (cond ((not (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)) (posp k))) (nfix (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))
       ((and (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) phase)
             (or (not (equal phase *fn2-overlay-phase-private*)) (equal (fn2-overlays-batch o fn2-overlays) b)))
        o)
       (t (fn2-idc-find-overlay (- k 1) (+ 1 o) phase b fn2-overlays))))
(defthm fn2-idc-find-overlay-natp (natp (fn2-idc-find-overlay k o phase b fn2-overlays)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(defun fn2-idc-count-overlays (k o phase fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp k))))
 (cond ((not (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)) (posp k))) 0)
       (t (+ (if (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) phase) 1 0)
             (fn2-idc-count-overlays (- k 1) (+ 1 o) phase fn2-overlays)))))
(defthm fn2-idc-count-overlays-natp (natp (fn2-idc-count-overlays k o phase fn2-overlays)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)

;; Shapes of the operations the successor uses (type, wfp, rows of every
;; stobj each returns), proved here once, each operation opened alone; READS
;; are folded (C-SHAPE-READS).
(defun fn2-idc-op-shape-disables (plain reads)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((eq plain :min) `(fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlay-index-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-pool-rows ,@reads))
       (plain `(fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlay-index-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-pool-rows
                fn2-id-engine-rows fn2-id-decides-rows
                fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-run-cursors-rows
                fn2-run-paths-rows fn2-run-installed-rows
                fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read
                fn2-pool-write fn2-pool-class-for ,@reads))
       (t `(fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlay-indexp fn2-overlay-index-wfp
            fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-poolp fn2-pool-wfp fn2-overlays-rows
            fn2-overlay-index-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-pool-rows
            fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write
            fn2-pool-class-for fn2-id-enginep fn2-id-engine-wfp fn2-id-engine-rows
            fn2-id-decidesp fn2-id-decides-wfp fn2-id-decides-rows ,@reads))))
;; One theorem per operation (machines.lisp fn2-shape-one): the claims about
;; every returned child are one predicate, proved by one walk of the
;; operation's paths; FN-IDC-SHAPE states the claims, for callers.
(defmacro fn2-idc-op-shape (fn args outs hyps &optional (plain 'nil) reads)
 (let ((outputs (if (consp (car outs)) outs (fn2-idc-shape-outs outs 1))))
  `(fn2-shape-one ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-IDC-SHAPE") ,fn ,args ,hyps
                  ,(fn2-fc-shape-claims outputs 'fn2-shape-r) ,(strip-cars outputs)
                  (,fn) ,(fn2-idc-op-shape-disables plain reads))))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-ov-start (o schema slot gen ibase icap okind oslot ogen cov fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-pool)
 (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) ((fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-ov-advance (o from to fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays) ((fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-ov-write (o pos ebase repl fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-pool)
 ((fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlay-indexp fn2-overlay-index)
  (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index) (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))

; Layer C in the served core (C-ONE-ASSEMBLY; seam C-S1, docs/c-ordered-runs.md
; §4a and §8): the engine's resident tables registered as core children, and
; each transaction's field-row stripe. The identity decision over them is
; machines-c-groups.lisp's (two exact reads); a transaction's writes go
; through the private successor (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp). The run
; and range assemblies are range-served.lisp's.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "range-served")
(include-book "machines-b")
(include-book "successor-schema-geometry")
(include-book "c-snapshot")
(include-book "checkpoint-summary-state")
(include-book "run-physical-geometry")
(include-book "run-physical-harvest")
(include-book "startup-genesis-state")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Field rows. B's format work uses a 128-row stripe per format slot from row 0
; (commit.lisp: base = 128 * row); transaction T's stripe is the
; *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*-row supported stripe ending (transactions - T) stripes before
; the table's end. machines-b sizes the table for both (fn2-b-field-rows). In
; a stripe (C-STRIPE): the successor's 24 write slots from +0, one 48-row
; block each (C-S3, machines-c-successor.lisp), then the exact lookup's area
; from +1152: its query at +4 (the identity decision's key: namespace, name,
; profile, algorithm, digest), the run reader at +84 (its rows also take the
; entry a bind writes).
(defconst *fn2-idc-stride* *fn2-b-txn-field-rows*)
(defconst *fn2-idc-b-stripe* 128)
(defconst *fn2-succ-slots* 24)

(defconst *fn2-idc-ident* (* *fn2-succ-slots* *fn2-succ-block*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-eb* (+ *fn2-idc-ident* 4))
(defconst *fn2-idc-rb* (+ *fn2-idc-eb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-required-fields*
 (fn2-successor-required-fields *fn2-succ-fields-max* *fn2-succ-values-max*
  *fn2-succ-slots* *fn2-run-entry-rows* *fn2-run-reader-fields*))
(assert-event (<= *fn2-idc-required-fields* *fn2-idc-stride*))
(assert-event (and (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-reader-fields*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ *fn2-idc-rb* *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (<= (+ (* (- *fn2-succ-slots* 1) *fn2-succ-block*) *fn2-run-entry-rows*) *fn2-idc-stride*)
                   (equal (fn2-b-field-rows '((:t . 3) (:format-slots . 2))) (+ (* 2 *fn2-idc-b-stripe*) (* 3 *fn2-idc-stride*) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* *fn2-b-checkpoint-field-rows*))))

;; The overlay rows a profile gets when it names none (:identity-overlays):
;; a batch takes one private overlay per schema it writes, and a POST
;; writes up to 10 today (the five identity records, article, outcome,
;; counts, overview, addr) of the 16 a transaction could name; B keeps two
;; batches in flight (its two commit rows) and the sealer works on the
;; frozen ones behind them. So 16 schemas x 3 batches. Each overlay in use
;; holds one arena of :identity-arena-bytes from the pool; the pool must
;; carry them (c-ordered-runs.md §5, capacity).
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlays-default* 48)
;; The sealer's merge (C5, sealer.lisp) reads at most eight sources, one run
;; cursor each, after every read row's (t + 9R ..).
(defconst *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 8)
;; A reader merges at most *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* (8) sources of a schema:
;; its overlays (active, frozen or private) and its live runs. The sealer
;; keeps a schema to *fn2-idc-run-budget* runs (it merges every run once a
;; schema holds that many, sealer.lisp) and stage keeps it to
;; *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* overlays (a transaction that would take one more
;; waits, :full, until the sealer catches up: machines-c-stage.lisp).
(defconst *fn2-idc-run-budget* 4)
(defconst *fn2-idc-overlay-budget* (- *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* *fn2-idc-run-budget*))
(defun fn2-idc-profilep (profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-profile-t profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-succ-slots* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
                             (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlay-entries 256 profile))))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-runs 64 profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :run-cache 1024 profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-capacity :identity-arena-bytes 65536 profile))
      ;; Layer D's read rows (C-S4, machines-c-read.lisp): R of them, each
      ;; with 8 range sources, a lookup row and cursor after the
      ;; transactions' (t + R) and 8 source cursors after those (t + 9R).
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 9 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 1))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (* 9 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) *fn2-idc-seal-cursors* 1)))
      (<= (+ (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix (fn2-b-format-slots profile)))
             (* *fn2-idc-stride* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* *fn2-b-checkpoint-field-rows*
             (* *fn2-b-read-stride* (fn2-b-read-rows profile)))
          (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :format-field-slots (fn2-b-field-rows profile) profile)))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile))
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ 4 (fn2-b-upload-windows profile) (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile)))))

;; Each child's init is a function whose guard is proved here once, so the
;; core init's guard (assembly-init) meets only the opaque profile predicate.
(defmacro fn2-idc-child (field stobj init why)
 (let ((fn (fn2-columns-sym stobj "-INIT-FOR")))
  `(progn
    (defun ,fn (profile ,stobj)
     (declare (xargs :stobjs ,stobj :guard (fn2-idc-profilep profile)
                     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep)))))
     ,init)
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-TYPE")
     (implies (and (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") ,stobj) (fn2-idc-profilep profile))
              (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-WFP")
     (implies (fn2-idc-profilep profile) (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "-WFP") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-idc-profilep))))
    (in-theory (disable ,fn))
    (defcorechild ,field ,stobj :init (,fn profile ,stobj) :profilep (fn2-idc-profilep profile) :why ,why))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-idc-profilep))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-csnapshot fn2-csnapshot (fn2-csnapshot-init 1 fn2-csnapshot)
 "One exact-owner resident metadata cut excludes staging and materialization until released.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-id-decides fn2-id-decides (fn2-id-decides-init (fn2-profile-t profile) fn2-id-decides)
 "One identity decision per transaction survives the transaction's yields (C-S1).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-overlays fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-init (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile) fn2-overlays)
 "Bounded sorted overlays hold facts not yet sealed into runs.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-overlay-index fn2-overlay-index
 (fn2-overlay-index-init (* (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlays *fn2-idc-overlays-default* profile))
                            (nfix (fn2-b-capacity :identity-overlay-entries 256 profile))) fn2-overlay-index)
 "Each overlay's key-ordered index of its arena's entries.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-installed fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-init (+ (fn2-b-capacity :identity-runs 64 profile) (fn2-b-capacity :extent-slots 16 profile)) fn2-run-installed)
 "The resident view of each schema's sealed runs.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-cursors fn2-run-cursors
 (fn2-run-cursors-init (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile) fn2-run-cursors)
 "A decision's resumable run cursor (cursor row = decision row), then each read row's lookup cursor and its range sources' (C-S4).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-checkpoint-summary-leases fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases
 (fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases-init (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile) fn2-checkpoint-summary-leases)
 "Every actual C cursor can retain one exact selected physical source across yields.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-loads fn2-run-loads
 (fn2-run-load-profile-init profile fn2-run-loads)
 "A private authenticated 64KiB page and sector workspace per active physical cursor.")
(defcorechild fn2-core-run-load-ops fn2-run-load-ops
 :init (fn2-run-load-ops-init (fn2-profile-o profile) fn2-run-load-ops)
 :profilep (unsigned-byte-p 32 (fn2-profile-o profile))
 :harvest (fn2-run-load-harvest ((fn2-core-run-loads fn2-run-loads) (fn2-core-run-load-ops fn2-run-load-ops)))
 :why "Route exact physical read completions before operation finish, without scanning active cursors.")
(defcorechild fn2-core-run-load-geometry fn2-run-load-geometry
 :init (fn2-run-load-geometry-profile-init profile fn2-run-load-geometry)
 :profilep (fn2-run-load-geometry-profilep profile)
 :why "Readonly profile-derived cursor/checker geometry binds the cold loader capability scan.")
(defcorechild fn2-core-run-load-readiness fn2-run-load-readiness
 :init (fn2-run-load-readiness-init 1 fn2-run-load-readiness) :profilep t
 :why "The cold capability scan retains selected identity, exact EOF and admissions serial across turns.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-paths fn2-run-paths
 (fn2-run-paths-init (* *fn2-run-max-levels* (fn2-b-run-cursor-rows profile)) fn2-run-paths)
 "Each cursor's descent, one row per level.")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-run-cache fn2-run-cache (fn2-run-cache-init (fn2-b-capacity :run-cache 1024 profile) fn2-run-cache)
 "Verified run pages, keyed by exact (unit, allocation counter).")

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Decision D's stripe base, or :bounds when D is no decision row or the
; stripes would reach into B's (FCROWS format slots).
(defun fn2-idc-stripe (d fcrows fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (let* ((n (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides)) (rows (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))
  (if (and (natp d) (< d n) (natp rows) (natp n)
           (<= (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix fcrows)) (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n))))
      (mv :ok (+ (- rows (* *fn2-idc-stride* n)) (* *fn2-idc-stride* d)))
    (mv :bounds 0))))

; The output positions of OUTS from POS, for the shape theorems
; (machines-c-successor.lisp's fn2-idc-fn-shape).
(defun fn2-idc-shape-outs (outs pos)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom outs) nil (cons (list (car outs) pos) (fn2-idc-shape-outs (cdr outs) (+ 1 pos)))))
after.books/machines-c-successor.lisp:
; Layer C in the served core, seam C-S3 (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §8 item 8):
; every engine write of a transaction goes through its batch's private
; successor. A transaction's write slots are declared at :prepare (put, arg,
; arg-octets, resolve); in its :ready arm, in one transition, stage computes
; every slot's row against the tip and holds room, out reads an assigned
; value, B admits the member, and bind writes every row into the batch's
; private overlays; release frees the slots at the outcome. B's commit kind
; publishes a batch (its private overlays, of every schema, readable in one
; step) or drops it. The tables, the engine row, the defcosts and the core
; wrappers (fn2-successor-prepare-events and -commit-events, materialized in
; assembly-callbacks-c-prepare and -commit) are three books': this one holds the tables,
; the declaring calls (put, arg, arg-octets) and resolve; machines-c-stage
; stage and out; machines-c-bind bind, release, publication, the defcosts
; and the wrappers (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-sealer-kind")
(include-book "identity-workspace-geometry")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
;; The assembly's dispatchers case-split over every schema id when open; the
;; successor treats them as opaque (their type facts are the assembly's).
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; C-ENGINE-OWNER (as built, C1c): the engine's workspaces (overlay arenas,
; the bind scratch, the sealer's pages) are owned by the sealer machine's row:
; kind = fn2-sealer's position in the registry (the index's *FN2-SEALER-KIND*,
; asserted equal in machines-c-sealer.lisp), local slot 0, generation 1. The
; local slot, not the global id, because these constants are used before the
; index exists.
(make-event (value `(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-kind*
                     ,(let ((pos (position-eq 'fn2-sealer (fn2-machine-names (w state))))) (if (natp pos) pos 254)))))
(assert-event (not (equal *fn2-idc-owner-kind* 254)))
(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-slot* 0)
(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-gen* 1)
; The bind scratch takes one slot's octets at a time: an entry's octet
; fields in field order from 0.


 ; C-STRIPE: ENTRY, RAW args, EVAL args, RES values and FRESH occupy
; disjoint declaration-derived regions. The generic run decoder's80-row guard
; is a table-tail reservation; its actual entry writes are the schema fields.
; successor-schema-geometry owns every offset and capacity.
(assert-event (<= (+ *fn2-succ-res* *fn2-succ-values-max*) *fn2-succ-fresh*))
(assert-event (< *fn2-succ-fresh* *fn2-succ-block*))

;; Every assembled schema and fold fits the inventory-derived slot; all
;; readable value fields fit RES, and its octets fit the actual scratch class.
(defun fn2-succ-kinds-fit (sid kinds)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom kinds) (and (<= (nfix (fn2-fold-arity sid (car kinds))) *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (fn2-succ-kinds-fit sid (cdr kinds)))))

(defun fn2-succ-schemas-fit (ids)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom ids)
     (let* ((sid (car ids)) (nf (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0)))
      (and (<= nf *fn2-succ-fields-max*)
           (<= (- nf (fn2-run-layout-keys sid)) *fn2-succ-values-max*)
           (fn2-succ-kinds-fit sid *fn2-run-fold-kinds*)
           (<= (fn2-succ-octets-total sid 0 nf) *fn2-idc-scratch-bytes*)
           (fn2-succ-schemas-fit (cdr ids))))))
(assert-event (fn2-succ-schemas-fit *fn2-run-assembled-ids*))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Tables. The engine row: the bind scratch (held once taken), the arena
; size, the next overlay sequence number. A transaction row (one per
; transaction, as its decision row): its phase, its batch and commit
; position once bound,
; resolve's progress (slot RI, run bound RBOUND), and an exact lookup's
; (machines-c-groups.lisp: LPHASE, LBOUND, LROW, LVER). A slot row (row
; T * 24 + I): schema, kind (:insert, or one of the folds' event
; kinds), the masks of args given (SET), given :event (EVENTS) and given
; :out (OUTS), what resolve found (FOUND, the schema's run version VRUN), the
; staged entry's SIZE, the owner its octet args are read under, the args
; declared late (LATE, C-S3a: octets given between stage and bind) and the
; late args filled since the last stage (FILLED).
; PUBLISHED: the greatest commit position publication has made readable
; (C-S4 amendment (c): D's frontier reads it, never derives it from overlays).
(defcolumns fn2-id-engine ((scratch :bool) (slot :u32) (gen :u60) (arena :u32) (seq :u60) (published :u60)))
(defun fn2-id-engine-init-arena (bytes fn2-id-engine)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-id-engine :guard (unsigned-byte-p 32 bytes)))
 (let ((fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-init 1 fn2-id-engine)))
  (fn2-id-engine-set-arena 0 bytes fn2-id-engine)))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-id-engine fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-init-arena (fn2-idc-profile-arena profile) fn2-id-engine)
 "The engine's bind scratch, arena size and overlay sequence (C-S3).")
(defcolumns fn2-succ-txns
 ((phase (:enum fn2-succ-phase (:idle :open :staged :bound :published)))
  (batch :u60) (event :u60)
  (ri :u32) (rstate (:enum fn2-succ-resolve (:fresh :next :look))) (rbound :u60)
  (lphase (:enum fn2-succ-lookup (:idle :overlays :runs :scan))) (lbound :u60) (lrow :u32) (lver :u60)))
(make-event
 `(defcolumns fn2-succ-slots
   ((phase (:enum fn2-succ-slot-phase (:empty :put :resolved)))
    (sid :u60) (kind (:enum fn2-succ-kind ,(append (cons :insert *fn2-run-fold-kinds*) '(:depend))))
    (set :u32) (events :u32) (outs :u32) (found :bool) (vrun :u60) (size :u32)
    (oset :bool) (sk :u8) (ss :u32) (sg :u60) (late :u32) (filled :u32) (unchanged :bool))))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-succ-txns
 (fn2-succ-txns-init (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) fn2-succ-txns)
 "A transaction's writes survive its yields between :prepare and its outcome (C-S3); then one row per read row, its exact lookup's continuation (C-S4).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-succ-slots fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-init (* *fn2-succ-slots* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))) fn2-succ-slots)
 "Each transaction's write slots (C-S3).")

; The first overlay row at or after O in phase PHASE (and, for a private
; one, of batch B); past the last, the row count.
(defun fn2-idc-find-overlay (k o phase b fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp k))))
 (cond ((not (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)) (posp k))) (nfix (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))
       ((and (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) phase)
             (or (not (equal phase *fn2-overlay-phase-private*)) (equal (fn2-overlays-batch o fn2-overlays) b)))

; Pure layout arithmetic shared by allocation admission and C's static schema
; inventory. A guard reservation is not an entry write footprint.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "format-base")
(fn2-book-layer :b)
(defun fn2-successor-block-fields (fields values)
 (declare (xargs :guard (and (natp fields) (natp values))))
 (+ (* 3 (nfix fields)) (nfix values) 1))
(defun fn2-successor-required-fields (fields values slots entry-guard reader-fields)
 (declare (xargs :guard (and (natp fields) (natp values) (natp slots) (natp entry-guard) (natp reader-fields))))
 (let ((block (fn2-successor-block-fields fields values)))
  (max (+ (* (nfix slots) block) 4 (nfix entry-guard) (nfix reader-fields))
       (+ (* (nfix (- (nfix slots) 1)) block) (nfix entry-guard)))))
(defun fn2-successor-scratch-bytes (octets)
 (declare (xargs :guard (natp octets)))
 (* *fn2-format-sector-size* (max 1 (ceiling (nfix octets) *fn2-format-sector-size*))))
(defthm fn2-successor-block-fields-covers-regions
 (implies (and (natp fields) (natp values))
  (and (<= fields (* 2 fields))
       (<= (* 2 fields) (* 3 fields))
       (< (+ (* 3 fields) values) (fn2-successor-block-fields fields values))))
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-successor-block-fields))))
after.books/successor-schema-geometry.lisp:
; Schema inventory is evaluated once by ACL2 at declaration time. No served
; operation scans declarations, and no article-specific field limit is used.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "runs-served")
(include-book "successor-workspace-geometry")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(defun fn2-succ-octets-total (sid f n)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil :measure (nfix (- (nfix n) (nfix f)))))
 (if (<= (nfix n) (nfix f)) 0 (+ (nfix (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid f)) (fn2-succ-octets-total sid (+ 1 (nfix f)) n))))
(defun fn2-successor-fold-args-max (sid kinds)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom kinds) 0
  (max (nfix (fn2-fold-arity sid (car kinds))) (fn2-successor-fold-args-max sid (cdr kinds)))))
(defun fn2-successor-schema-bounds (ids)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom ids) '(0 0 0)
  (let* ((sid (car ids)) (nf (nfix (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0)))
         (nk (nfix (fn2-run-layout-keys sid)))
         (rest (fn2-successor-schema-bounds (cdr ids))))
   (list (max nf (fn2-successor-fold-args-max sid *fn2-run-fold-kinds*) (nfix (car rest)))
         (max (nfix (- nf nk)) (nfix (cadr rest)))
         (max (fn2-succ-octets-total sid 0 nf) (nfix (caddr rest)))))))
(make-event
 (let ((bounds (fn2-successor-schema-bounds *fn2-run-assembled-ids*)))
  (value `(progn
    (defconst *fn2-succ-fields-max* ,(car bounds))
    (defconst *fn2-succ-values-max* ,(cadr bounds))
    (defconst *fn2-succ-octets-max* ,(caddr bounds))))))
(defconst *fn2-succ-entry* 0)
(defconst *fn2-succ-raw* *fn2-succ-fields-max*)
(defconst *fn2-succ-eval* (+ *fn2-succ-raw* *fn2-succ-fields-max*))
(defconst *fn2-succ-res* (+ *fn2-succ-eval* *fn2-succ-fields-max*))
(defconst *fn2-succ-fresh* (+ *fn2-succ-res* *fn2-succ-values-max*))
(defconst *fn2-succ-block* (fn2-successor-block-fields *fn2-succ-fields-max* *fn2-succ-values-max*))
(defconst *fn2-idc-scratch-bytes* (fn2-successor-scratch-bytes *fn2-succ-octets-max*))
; Bind cost propagation is a separate actual-call audit, not an inferred
; bound from per-entry scratch size. This book changes no byte-cost claim.
(assert-event
 (and (<= *fn2-succ-fields-max* 32)
      (<= *fn2-succ-values-max* *fn2-succ-fields-max*)
      (< *fn2-succ-fresh* 256)
      (<= *fn2-succ-fields-max* *fn2-succ-raw*)
      (<= (+ *fn2-succ-raw* *fn2-succ-fields-max*) *fn2-succ-eval*)
      (<= (+ *fn2-succ-eval* *fn2-succ-fields-max*) *fn2-succ-res*)
      (<= (+ *fn2-succ-res* *fn2-succ-values-max*) *fn2-succ-fresh*)
      (< *fn2-succ-fresh* *fn2-succ-block*)
      (<= *fn2-succ-octets-max* *fn2-idc-scratch-bytes*)))
